Resolves #19382

ADR 0034 §2.3 item 10 now states the `fresh` flag on `setupEvaluate`: `fresh: true` starts a new run for the target, the broker binds a new record and answers the run it retired, the held run stays on disk as history unread and unchanged, it is the one request a broker still answers over a record it cannot read, and a `fresh` that is not a boolean is refused by name. The amendment line names this leaf and neomjs/neo-agent-institution#475, whose PR consumes it; this merges first.

Evidence: L1 (docs only, no runtime path) → L1 required (AC-1 … AC-3).

Micro-review eligible: docs — one ADR item, no runtime impact (the cross-family mandate's micro-change exception).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | the diff: `learn/agentos/decisions/0034-electron-shell-architecture.md` §2.3 item 10, the amendment line and the `setupEvaluate({target, fresh})` bullet; the Institution PR for #475 names this leaf under Decision Record impact and merges after it |
| AC-2 | the bullet's sentences name the request, the reply and the refusal; no file or symbol beyond the channel's own name |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the PR body job, one standalone `Resolves` |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive: the parked branch's three hunks re-applied onto today's item 10 — the `setupEffect({effectId, newAttempt})` bullet stays as dev wrote it (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#540), and the serialized-operations paragraph, which already carries the read-from-disk rule, gains only its fresh-run clause.
